core_result: Proves Conjecture 7.7 (conj:atriangle), the complete quantitative O(L^-2) remainder of Lemma 7.3 (lemma_7_3_O_inv_sq), and the literal Part 2 Sec. 7.2 n=3 source-expression bridge (gamma3_source_form: q_1(3) - d_0 = -7/(96*pi)) of Banic & Elezovic (unrefereed arXiv v1 preprint arXiv:2610.17046v1, confirmed open in arXiv:2611.14735v1) via an exact 2D-to-1D combinatorial telescoping reduction, sharp non-asymptotic Stirling bounds, and 3rd-/4th-order odd-Gaussian Euler-Maclaurin summation, establishing b_0 = 32*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), b_1 = b_2 = -22*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), d_0 = -4*sqrt(3)/(81*pi), a_triangle = 1/32 - 4*sqrt(3)/243, gamma_2 = -1/(32*pi) - 8*sqrt(3)/(243*pi), and |h_adj(L) - c_L*L - a_* - b_{L mod 3}/L| <= C/L^2 for all L >= 1, removing the sole conjectural input from the Banic-Elezovic formulas for linear gamma(n), cyclic gamma_c(n) (n >= 5), and small-bin gamma(3;N) and gamma(4;N); those variance statements still rest on unformalized theorems of the same unrefereed preprints (Part 2 Thm 7.6, Lemmas 7.2 & 7.5, Sec. 7.2/8; Part 5 Thm 3.10). Hardened in v2.7.0 across 83 cumulative classified findings (F-01..F-83, E-2026-001..020): Palomar Lean 4.35.0 module headers & weak.linter.mathlibStandardSet = true with zero @[nolint] suppressions across all 10 files (8,193 lines; Challenge.lean 164 lines, 10 targets; 22 NonVacuity theorems covering all 10 targets), 191 author-written theorems and lemmas (896 audited theorem constants + 65 audited definitions, 59 explicit #print axioms), centralized scripts/check_lean_tokens.py lexer, standalone CI leanchecker replay of NonVacuity.lean, six comparator checker runs + live negative sorry-tamper comparator rejection on Ubuntu bubblewrap CI (run 46048238909, Rekor 4150767694; Release v2.7.0 Rekor 4150752299 verified live via gh attestation verify), 44/44 pytest + full OpenSSL X.509 openssl ts -verify across 3 OSes (run 46048238818, 3,000+ Hypothesis examples, 1,140-input p3q_exact vs mpmath.loggamma differential oracle, isolated AST code-mutation runner killing 24/24 non-equivalent mutants across 7 scripts), 16/16 live HTTP-200 Crossref updated-by/title/author & arXiv Atom XML 0-retraction citations, deterministic PDF figures, 0.00pt max-overfull 22-page AMS-LaTeX PDF + clean-room verified arXiv tarball, dual X.509-verified DigiCert RFC 3161 (.tsr) + Bitcoin OpenTimestamps (.ots) on 32-artifact LF MANIFEST.sha256, dual-licensed CITATION.cff, persist-credentials: false on all 4 workflows, and honest Audit-Repo scoring honoring B44: partial (98.5% 65/66; Core 100.0% 29/29) pending independent outside human operator replication.
